data.lyrics:
"""
[Intro]
Uh, cooking tonight!

[Hook]
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
More or less… Más o menos
Come and cook with me.
Four, five, six… Cuatro, cinco, seis
Let's mix it, fix it, just like this.
Cooking dinner, feeling right.
English, Spanish, aquí tonight.

[Verse]
Chop the onions, cut the cheese,
Varios ingredientes, if you please.
A little salt… Un poco de sal
Pocos ingredientes, not at all.
Many hands… Muchas manos
Make the work go fast, you know.
Some spice… Algún condimento
No salt… Nada de sal
Double the love… Doble amor
Triple the fun… Triple diversión
Cooking with you is quadruple the sun.

[Hook]
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
More or less… Más o menos
Come and cook with me.
Four, five, six… Cuatro, cinco, seis
Let's mix it, fix it, just like this.
Cooking dinner, feeling right.
English, Spanish, aquí tonight.

[Verse]
Quince minutos, dinner's almost done,
Stir it up, aquí vamos.
A little taste… Un poco de probar
No more waiting… Nada de esperar
